reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes OneCoin as a new cryptocurrency, uses success-oriented messaging and claims about Bitcoin's rise and global participation to make the coin appealing, and directs viewers to register at a specified destination. the available video evidence does not establish what registration requires or what outcome follows, so those details remain unresolved.

citations.quote: Be successful with OneCoin Free registration http://onecoin.eu/signup/vitalie65
A new, innovative crypto- coin is introduced into the market.
1-Coin is aiming for the sky and will become one of the most successful currencies on the crypto market.
Bitcoin rises in value with more than a 1000%
Already expanding into a worldwide mining network and creating history again in the cryptocurrency industry.

opening.argument: Judge, the narration presents OneCoin’s future standing as an ambition, not an accomplished return: its founder is described as “dedicated to achieve her ambitious goal” [ASR_0002]. The prediction that the coin “will become one of the most successful currencies” [ASR_0001] is promotional, but it specifies no payout or timetable for a viewer. The description offers “Free registration” [DESCRIPTION_0001], not an expressed requirement to buy a token. There is no explicit risk warning here; the narrower point is that these statements do not themselves promise an investor a guaranteed result.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution cites Bitcoin’s past rise [ASR_0001], but that is not a stated return for OneCoin. It also acknowledges that the evidence does not establish what registration requires or what follows. The invitation says registration is free [DESCRIPTION_0001]. Promotional confidence and a signup link deserve scrutiny, but neither quote establishes a purchase, dividend, or guaranteed appreciation.

citations.quote: Bitcoin rises in value with more than a 1000%
Free registration http://onecoin.eu/signup/vitalie65

true_side_reply.rebuttal: An ambition need not be a guaranteed return to serve as a financial lure. The narration predicts market success for the named coin [ASR_0001], while the description couples “Be successful with OneCoin” to a signup destination [DESCRIPTION_0001]. The absence of a stated purchase or completed investment limits what can be concluded about later steps; it does not erase the video’s promotion of the currency through anticipated success.

citations.quote: 1-Coin is aiming for the sky and will become one of the most successful currencies on the crypto market.
Be successful with OneCoin Free registration http://onecoin.eu/signup/vitalie65

opening.argument: Judge, much of the narration is an introductory account of cryptocurrency: it dates the start of a new financial era to 2009, identifies Bitcoin as the first cryptocurrency, and discusses inflation’s effect on traditional currency [ASR_0001]. It then places the introduction of a new coin within that broader account [ASR_0001]. Read in that sequence, the video can be understood as explaining why its speaker sees cryptocurrency as significant, rather than instructing viewers how to invest. The description’s registration link [DESCRIPTION_0001] makes the presentation promotional, but the supplied narration gives no procedure for buying a token.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution treats the historical comparison and mining-network claim as reasons to sign up. But the quoted Bitcoin rise concerns Bitcoin, not a documented OneCoin return [ASR_0001], and the network claim describes asserted reach, not a transaction offered to viewers [ASR_0001]. The link is real [DESCRIPTION_0001]; it does not make every preceding explanation an investment instruction.

citations.quote: Bitcoin rises in value with more than a 1000%
Already expanding into a worldwide mining network and creating history again in the cryptocurrency industry.
Free registration http://onecoin.eu/signup/vitalie65

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The background is not neutral instruction in how cryptocurrency works. It culminates in “We are introducing 1-Coin to the market” [ASR_0001] and a prediction of its success [ASR_0001]. Paired with “Be successful with OneCoin” and a registration destination [DESCRIPTION_0001], the historical material functions as a pitch for this particular currency. No purchase procedure need be shown for that promotional purpose to be apparent.

citations.quote: We are introducing 1-Coin to the market.
1-Coin is aiming for the sky and will become one of the most successful currencies on the crypto market.
Be successful with OneCoin Free registration http://onecoin.eu/signup/vitalie65

opening.argument: Judge, the one concrete viewer-facing offer in the supplied text is “Free registration” at a signup link [DESCRIPTION_0001]. That is consistent with an ordinary referral promotion. The title calls OneCoin a new cryptocurrency [TITLE_0001], and the narration predicts it will become successful [ASR_0001], but neither cited passage gives a token price, asks for a deposit, describes downline income, or promises a viewer a dividend. The record does not show what happens after registration, so it cannot establish that the link initiates a payment or investment scheme. Treating an unspecified next step as though it were shown would go beyond this video’s evidence.

citations.quote: Be successful with OneCoin Free registration http://onecoin.eu/signup/vitalie65
OneCoin is a NEW crypto currency
1-Coin is aiming for the sky and will become one of the most successful currencies on the crypto market.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution is right that the video makes the coin appealing and supplies a destination. Its cited destination, however, expressly describes registration as free [DESCRIPTION_0001]. The cited prediction concerns the currency’s prospective market standing [ASR_0001], not a stated payment to registrants. The prosecution’s own account leaves registration’s requirements and outcome unresolved; those unknowns should not be filled in with an imagined deposit or dividend.

citations.quote: Free registration http://onecoin.eu/signup/vitalie65
1-Coin is aiming for the sky and will become one of the most successful currencies on the crypto market.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: “Free registration” does not establish that the destination is harmless; it only describes the advertised first step [DESCRIPTION_0001]. The video explicitly introduces the coin to the market [ASR_0001], forecasts its success [ASR_0001], and directs the resulting interest to a signup link [DESCRIPTION_0001]. The evidence does not prove a deposit, downline payment, or dividend, but the defense’s missing-mechanism argument does not account for the promotion that is actually present.
